name: Tukora Connect
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original, premium, professionally finished logo for a modern organization and team communication product named exactly "Tukora Connect". This product connects teams, member directories, conversations and organization workspaces. High-resolution square canvas with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Build a distinctive, elegant geometric emblem from two interlocking folded ribbons with a subtle T or conversation shape in their negative space. Balanced human connection, precision, trust. Colors: clear azure blue #2374AD and fresh emerald #45C78C for the emblem, deep navy #142E45 for the wordmark. The mark must have a strong silhouette, clean edges and convincing optical balance. A refined geometric sans-serif wordmark, beautifully kerned; Tukora on the main line with Connect smaller beneath if this improves the lockup. Exact spelling: T-u-k-o-r-a and C-o-n-n-e-c-t. Center the emblem above the wordmark in one balanced stacked composition, generous clear space, entirely within the central 80% of the canvas. Use flat vector-like colors and crisp shapes, no photography or mockup. No shadow, 3D extrusion, background panel, checkerboard, badge, texture, decorative particles, tagline, registration symbol, extra lettering, or previous brand names. Output only the completed logo on true transparency.

name: Whizlume
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original premium logo for a modern course-learning and tutoring product named exactly "Whizlume". It supports course discovery, program workspaces and teaching journeys. Create a distinctive continuous folded W emblem that also suggests an opening book or two ascending learning paths, with one restrained warm-orange spark at the upper-right as a symbol of an idea. It must look like a carefully crafted identity, never generic clip art or a graduation-cap stock icon. Brand palette: deep violet #5B35B5 with a small warm orange #FF8B36 accent; wordmark in rich dark plum #281D42. High-resolution square with genuinely transparent alpha background. Premium geometric-humanist sans-serif wordmark with excellent kerning and exact spelling W-h-i-z-l-u-m-e. Place the emblem above the single-line Whizlume wordmark in a refined centered stacked lockup, balanced negative space and clear proportions; all artwork inside the central 80% with no cropped parts. Crisp vector-like flat shapes, polished optical geometry, professional and welcoming. No photographic effects, shadows, 3D, bevels, background, checkerboard, white rectangle, container tile, slogan, extra text, old names or trademark symbols. Output only the logo on true transparency.

name: Alumvia
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE distinctive premium brand logo for a student learning and educational-services platform named exactly "Alumvia". This is an online-learning introduction and student-service platform; do not imply it is an alumni-only social network. Design an elegant abstract A emblem using a flowing path or two unfolding pages: progress through learning, guidance, clarity. Sophisticated, warm, modern, human. Palette: aqua teal #19ACB1, deeper teal #087C88, and one small coral #F07D8E accent as a path endpoint; dark teal #164451 wordmark. Render in crisp, clean, vector-like flat shapes with immaculate curves and generous negative space. Exact wordmark A-l-u-m-v-i-a, refined contemporary sans-serif with carefully balanced kerning, no decorative script. A genuinely transparent alpha background on a high-resolution square canvas. Use one centered stacked lockup with emblem above the one-line Alumvia wordmark. Ensure complete logo, ample clear space within the central 80% of the square. No stock graduation cap, laurel wreath, university crest, photograph, glossy mockup, shadow, 3D, background, checkerboard, colored or white panel, tagline, extra words, previous name or trademark symbols. Output only the finished logo with true transparency.

name: KegelTempo
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original, refined premium logo for an exercise and wellbeing routine product named exactly "KegelTempo". It presents pelvic-floor exercise routines, timing, a calendar and activity graphics. The identity should communicate a steady rhythm, care and a manageable daily routine without medical efficacy claims. Invent a balanced circular rhythmic emblem using two elegant nested upward arcs or soft flowing U shapes and one small timing dot; the negative space can subtly suggest a K or a gentle pulse. Calm, discreet, confident, inclusive and professional. Palette reflects the current sunny yellow identity in a more refined way: warm golden yellow #E9B82D and deeper ochre #C69118, with a warm charcoal #32302A wordmark. Flat clean vector-like shapes, smooth exact curves, excellent small-size readability, no delicate detail. High-resolution square with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Center one tasteful stacked lockup: emblem above a single-line geometric-humanist sans-serif wordmark spelling K-e-g-e-l-T-e-m-p-o exactly, no space. Keep every part within the central 80% of the canvas and provide ample clear space. No anatomy, medical cross, claims, stock fitness figure, clock numerals, clinical badge, background, checkerboard, white panel, 3D, shadow, texture, slogan, additional words, old names or trademark symbols. Output only the complete logo on true transparency.
